auth.v1.AcceptTermsRequest.description: AcceptTermsRequest records explicit consent to the currently required terms.
auth.v1.AcceptTermsRequest.title: AcceptTermsRequest

auth.v1.AcceptTermsResponse.description:
AcceptTermsResponse confirms acceptance. Repeated acceptance of the current
 version succeeds and preserves the first acceptance time.
auth.v1.AcceptTermsResponse.title: AcceptTermsResponse

auth.v1.CreateWalletChallengeRequest.description:
CreateWalletChallengeRequest requests a short-lived EIP-4361 message whose
 exact UTF-8 bytes must be signed by the wallet.

purpose.description: Operation for which the challenge may be consumed.
purpose.title: purpose

signerAddress.description:
EVM address selected in the wallet and written into the EIP-4361 message.
 For CREATE_SUBACCOUNT, this must equal smart_account_address.
signerAddress.title: signer_address

smartAccountAddress.description: Smart-account EVM address being authenticated, formatted as 0x plus 40 hex characters.
smartAccountAddress.title: smart_account_address

uri.description:
Browser origin URI requesting the signature, including scheme and optional
 port but no path, query, fragment, or user information.
uri.title: uri

auth.v1.CreateWalletChallengeRequest.title: CreateWalletChallengeRequest

auth.v1.CreateWalletChallengeResponse.description: CreateWalletChallengeResponse contains the canonical EIP-4361 message.

expiresAt.description: Time in UTC when the challenge expires. Wallet challenges expire after 5 minutes.
expiresAt.title: expires_at

message.description:
Canonical EIP-4361 message. Sign these UTF-8 bytes exactly once with
 personal_sign; do not hash, alter, or reconstruct the message.
message.title: message

auth.v1.CreateWalletChallengeResponse.title: CreateWalletChallengeResponse

auth.v1.LoginWithWalletRequest.description:
LoginWithWalletRequest completes smart-account wallet login using the exact
 server-issued EIP-4361 message and its signature.

ip.description:
Optional caller IP address for account security and audit displays. Maximum
 length is 64 characters.
ip.title: ip

message.description:
Exact EIP-4361 message returned by CreateWalletChallenge. Maximum length is
 4096 UTF-8 bytes.
string.max_bytes = 4096
message.title: message

signature.description:
Signature over message using EIP-191 personal_sign semantics. Maximum
 length is 8192 characters to support universal wallet signatures.
signature.title: signature

smartAccountAddress.description:
Smart-account EVM address bound into the challenge resource, formatted as
 0x plus 40 hex characters.
smartAccountAddress.title: smart_account_address

userAgent.description:
Optional user-agent string for account security and audit displays. Maximum
 length is 512 characters.
userAgent.title: user_agent

walletProvider.description: Optional provider hint for the signing wallet. Maximum length is 32 characters.
walletProvider.title: wallet_provider

auth.v1.LoginWithWalletRequest.title: LoginWithWalletRequest

auth.v1.LoginWithWalletResponse.description:
LoginWithWalletResponse returns a session token for the authenticated root
 account.

accessToken.description: Bearer access token for authenticated API calls.
accessToken.title: access_token

accountId.description: Root account the token is bound to (opaque ID).
accountId.title: account_id

expiresAt.description: Time in UTC when access_token expires.
expiresAt.title: expires_at

session.description: Session assurance details for the issued access token.
session.title: session

username.description: Optional current username for the root account (empty if not set).
username.title: username

auth.v1.LoginWithWalletResponse.title: LoginWithWalletResponse

auth.v1.MeResponse.description: MeResponse describes the authenticated caller and current session context.

apiKeyId.description:
Stable public identifier of the API key that authenticated this request,
 formatted as "ak_" followed by 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
 Absent when the request was not authenticated with an API key.
apiKeyId.title: api_key_id

rootSmartAccountAddress.description:
Root smart-account EVM address, formatted as 0x plus 40 hex characters.
 Empty if not set.
rootSmartAccountAddress.title: root_smart_account_address

session.description: Session assurance details for the presented access token, if any.
session.title: session

username.description: Optional current username for the root account (empty if not set).
username.title: username

auth.v1.MeResponse.title: MeResponse

post.description: Verify a server-issued EIP-4361 wallet message and issue an access token for the caller account. This does not accept terms.

polyester.exchange wants you to sign in with your Ethereum account:
0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555

Sign in to Polyester. This does not authorize a transaction.

Version: 1
Chain ID: 888168
